name: fernweh-reise
description: Plan and run your own trips with the Fernweh travel guide (fernweh.guide): curated destinations, round trips, your trips, day plans, budget and travel mode.

interface.longDescription:
Fernweh is a curated travel guide with a trip planner. With this plugin ChatGPT plans with your own Fernweh trips: it looks up destinations, places, sights, restaurants, curated round trips and the best time to travel in the guide, creates trips, adds stops, nights, transport, accommodation and bookings, fills day plans, logs expenses against the budget and tells you what is on today while you travel. Every change appears in the Fernweh app at once.

Who it is for: travellers with a Fernweh account (free sign-up at fernweh.guide). You sign in with OAuth; the plugin only sees the public guide, your own trips and your saved list.

Limitations: the guide covers the destinations Fernweh has written about, in German and English. Fernweh does not book or pay for anything. Hotel, flight and rental-car search links are partly affiliate links and are always labelled. Deleting a trip, stop, activity or expense is confirmed with you first.
defaultPrompt: Plan a 10-day trip through Portugal in May.
When is the best time to travel to Sri Lanka?
What is on today on my trip?

positive.description: Find a destination in the guide
positive.prompt: Which destinations does Fernweh have in Portugal?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Portuguese locations from the Fernweh guide with a short description each, labelled as fernweh.guide content.

positive.prompt: When is the best time to travel to Portugal?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the recommended months with temperatures and rain from the guide's weather data.

positive.prompt: Create a trip to Portugal from 1 to 10 May with three nights in Lisbon and four in Porto.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the trip with the date range and two stops with the requested nights; the trip appears in the test account's Fernweh app.

positive.prompt: Show me my trips and what is still missing for the next one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's trips and, for the next one, the stays and legs that are not booked yet.

positive.prompt: Add 45 euros for dinner in Lisbon to my Portugal trip and show the budget.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the expense to the trip and reports the updated budget totals.

negative.description: Booking and payment are out of scope
negative.prompt: Book and pay for a hotel in Lisbon for me with my credit card.

negative.description: Another user's trips are not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me the trips of the user anna@example.com.
Write me a cover letter for a software job.

review.commerce_description: Fernweh does not sell products or process payments. Some hotel, flight and rental-car search links are labelled affiliate links (Stay22); bookings happen on the partner's site.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: travel guide, trips, day plans, budget, saved list and travel mode.

de-DE.subtitle: Reisen planen mit Fernweh
de-DE.description:
Fernweh ist ein kuratierter Reiseführer mit Reiseplaner. Mit diesem Plugin plant ChatGPT mit deinen eigenen Fernweh-Reisen: Es schlägt Reiseziele, Orte, Sehenswürdigkeiten, Restaurants, Rundreisen und die beste Reisezeit im Reiseführer nach, legt Reisen an, ergänzt Stationen, Nächte, Anreise, Unterkünfte und Buchungen, füllt Tagespläne, trägt Ausgaben ins Budget ein und sagt dir unterwegs, was heute ansteht. Jede Änderung erscheint sofort in der Fernweh-App.

Für wen: Reisende mit Fernweh-Konto (kostenlos auf fernweh.guide). Die Anmeldung läuft über OAuth; das Plugin sieht nur den öffentlichen Reiseführer, deine eigenen Reisen und deine Merkliste.

Grenzen: Der Reiseführer umfasst die Ziele, über die Fernweh geschrieben hat, auf Deutsch und Englisch. Fernweh bucht und bezahlt nichts. Hotel-, Flug- und Mietwagen-Suchlinks sind teilweise Affiliate-Links und immer gekennzeichnet. Bevor eine Reise, Station, Aktivität oder Ausgabe gelöscht wird, fragt der Assistent nach.
